intro.Body: Tribute Portfolio standards vary by asset type, conversion path, market, operating model, and agreement vintage. Use this table as an owner planning checklist — confirm every requirement with current brand disclosure, design standards, and transaction documents before making capital commitments.

requirements.title: Breakfast / Morning Meal
requirements.body:
Typical consideration: Morning meal requirements may depend on asset type, market, operating model, and approved brand program.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm whether the asset needs breakfast, café, restaurant, or other approved morning offering before underwriting staffing and FF&E.
Typical status: May Apply
Notes to confirm: Confirm current Tribute standards, market expectations, and brand approval requirements.

columns.typical: Morning meal requirements may depend on asset type, market, operating model, and approved brand program.
columns.owner: Confirm whether the asset needs breakfast, café, restaurant, or other approved morning offering before underwriting staffing and FF&E.
columns.notes: Confirm current Tribute standards, market expectations, and brand approval requirements.

requirements.title: F&B / Bar / Local Programming
requirements.body:
Typical consideration: Tribute properties often rely on local character, social spaces, and destination-relevant programming rather than a purely standardized prototype.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm restaurant, bar, event, and local programming expectations early because they can materially affect capex, staffing, and operator scope.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Confirm whether the property's concept, operator, and market support the required experience level.

columns.typical: Tribute properties often rely on local character, social spaces, and destination-relevant programming rather than a purely standardized prototype.
columns.owner: Confirm restaurant, bar, event, and local programming expectations early because they can materially affect capex, staffing, and operator scope.
columns.notes: Confirm whether the property's concept, operator, and market support the required experience level.

requirements.title: Lobby / Public Space
requirements.body:
Typical consideration: Public areas should support independent lifestyle positioning, arrival experience, and locally relevant guest touchpoints.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm lobby layout, FF&E, brand identity moments, and conversion flexibility before finalizing design scope.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Historic or adaptive-reuse assets may need project-specific design review.

columns.typical: Public areas should support independent lifestyle positioning, arrival experience, and locally relevant guest touchpoints.
columns.owner: Confirm lobby layout, FF&E, brand identity moments, and conversion flexibility before finalizing design scope.
columns.notes: Historic or adaptive-reuse assets may need project-specific design review.

requirements.title: Guestroom Standards
requirements.body:
Typical consideration: Guestrooms should align with Tribute's lifestyle positioning while meeting Marriott system, quality, and guest-experience expectations.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm bedding, bathroom, FF&E, technology, and room-mix implications before locking renovation budgets.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Conversion projects may need project-specific brand and design review.

columns.typical: Guestrooms should align with Tribute's lifestyle positioning while meeting Marriott system, quality, and guest-experience expectations.
columns.owner: Confirm bedding, bathroom, FF&E, technology, and room-mix implications before locking renovation budgets.
columns.notes: Conversion projects may need project-specific brand and design review.

requirements.title: Signage / Exterior Identity
requirements.body:
Typical consideration: Exterior identity should balance Tribute affiliation with the property's independent character and local context.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm monument signage, façade treatment, preservation limits, and permitting before committing to exterior scope.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Historic, urban, or mixed-use assets may require additional local approvals.

requirements.title: Technology / Systems
requirements.body:
Typical consideration: Participation in Marriott systems can require PMS, CRS, loyalty, reporting, Wi-Fi, and distribution readiness.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm system cutover timing, training, integration costs, and operating responsibilities with the brand and operator.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Technology scope may vary by agreement, market, and conversion timing.

columns.owner: Confirm system cutover timing, training, integration costs, and operating responsibilities with the brand and operator.

requirements.title: Training / QA / Brand Standards
requirements.body:
Typical consideration: Brand onboarding, training, quality assurance, and standards compliance should be planned before opening or conversion.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm inspection timing, remediation responsibilities, operating procedures, and ongoing QA cadence.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Confirm current Marriott/Tribute review process, required training, and post-opening compliance obligations.
